The structure of composition Zn8Sb4Se4 (reduced formula Zn2SbSe) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination for all centers: each Sb and Se is surrounded by four Zn neighbors, while each Zn is coordinated by two Sb and two Se neighbors, with neighbor distances of 2.546–2.553 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Zn–Zn tetrahedra sharing corners, while Sb–Se tetrahedra share edges.
